newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps mixed, CFDs up 10 ct, contango eras.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps mixed, CFDs up 10 ct, contango eras.

text.p: European oil swaps were mixed on Thursday with Brent crude firmer but gasoline down $3 a tonne.

Brent CFDs climbed 10 cents a barrel after stonrg demand for Brent which traded at 35 cents under June. By late afternoon the next three weeks were all broadly flat at around 33 or 34 cents under having been in contango during the morning session.
Dealers said there was strong demand for Brent from U.S. refiners and refinery margins in Europe remain good.

Gasoline swaps fell $3 a tonne to $194.50 for May and were $3.50 lower for June. Rotterdam barges traded at $197 for loading up to May 15 but later at $194.50 for similar dates. July talked some $3.75 below June.
Naphtha fell $1 a tonne to $177.50 for May.

Heavy fuel firmed $1.50 a tonne to trade around $83.50 for May barges. The forward periods were pegged around $83.75 for July, $84.50 for July, $86 for the third quarter and $91.25 for the fourth quarter.
Low sulphur was valued around $89 for May but activity was thin.

Jet premiums were flat with May bid at $24.50 a tonne above the IPE after trading at that level last Thursday. The third and fourth quarters were little changed at $27.50 and $31.50 above the screen respectively.
